An unknown address that sent events carries seen: the names it went by, the conversations it spoke in last (with their organizations), when, how often, and, for a Telegram or Slack user id, profile: what it wrote about itself (a Telegram bio, a Slack title), a self-description rather than evidence.

get.description: Every rule the organization has authored, armed or not, in the order the active ones run. Unpaged: the rule set is a bounded catalog, not a feed.

put.description: Authors a rule or revises the one already carrying this name. The DSL is validated here — a rule the engine could never bind is refused rather than stored to silently never fire.

delete.description: Retires a rule. Soft, so the mutations it authored still resolve to the rule that made them.

put.summary: Sonar: Arm or Disarm a Rule
put.description: Flips a rule on or off without touching what it says — stopping a misfiring rule should not require editing it.

get.description: Get products with pagination and server-side filtering

kind.description: email; tg_id (a Telegram user id) or tg_handle (@name); slack_id (U…).

lastContactAt.description: When we were last in contact with the person: when the latest event naming them, as its sender or anywhere it names people, happened. Null when no event has named them yet. What sort=recent / stale order by, nulls last either way.

updatedAt.description: When the contact was last written.

since.description: First day of the stint (YYYY-MM-DD), when known.

until.description: Last day of the stint (YYYY-MM-DD). Absent = current.

draft.description: Agent only: hold this write as a draft for a person to approve, even where the permissions would let it through. The response is applied=false with the draft.

fields.description: The contact card's values (GET /entity-cards). No card, no fields.

eventId.description: The event cited; or messageId, one of the two.

messageId.description: A teammate's message cited (a text or an answer they sent), instead of an event. Supports only.

quotes.description: Verbatim excerpts of what is cited, showing what was read. An agent write needs at least one on a supporting event, or a message.

stance.description: supports (default) or retracts — a retraction takes back an event an earlier write cited, and needs no quote.

mine.description: Derived, beside owner: the signed-in person's contact is the owner. Absent when there is no owner, or the reader has no contact in this silo.

owner.description: Derived, on a question read through GET /messages: the one of ours it waits on, from what it is about (the senders of its events, the members behind the messages a change it names cites, the key member of its threads or of the threads holding its events). Absent when none of these names one of ours. It routes, and limits nobody: anyone may answer.

mine.description: Derived, beside owner: the signed-in person's contact is the owner. Absent when there is no owner, or the reader has no contact in this silo.

owner.description: Derived, on GET /mutations/drafts: the one of ours this draft waits on, from the senders of the events it cites, else the member behind a message it cites, else the key member of the threads holding those events. Absent when none of these names one of ours. It routes, and limits nobody: anyone may decide the draft.

addresses.description: Addresses to accrete (append-only ensure); one that belongs to another contact is refused — that is merge territory.

draft.description: Agent only: hold this write as a draft for a person to approve, even where the permissions would let it through. The response is applied=false with the draft.

fields.description: Patch of the contact card's values; "" clears one. Only fields the card declares (GET /entity-cards) are accepted.

removeAddresses.description: Address values to drop. A contact cannot lose its last address; delete the contact instead.
